facts.business: Square Four Projects India Limited is a real estate and infrastructure development company with investments in wholly owned subsidiaries and group entities engaged in construction and housing projects.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material weakness in internal financial controls regarding periodic fair valuation of unquoted investments aggregating Rs. 39.50 lakh under Ind AS 109; investments carried at cost instead of fair value.

key_risks: Outcome of regulatory approvals for recommencing project activity
Resolution of qualified audit matter concerning fair valuation of investments
General economic and real estate market conditions in India
facts.related_party_note: Investments in unquoted equity shares of wholly owned subsidiary BRC Construction Co. Private Limited and other group entities Square Four Asset Management & Reconstruction Co. Private Limited and Square Four Housing & Infrastructure Development Private Limited; related-party loans exist.
